Maya (CS): NimblePay onboarding — they're hitting a cascade of 429s when enabling session prefetch. Reported spike right after first few users. Can someone quick-check what the SDK is doing?
Alex (Platform): On it. Do you have a short repro or logs?
Maya (CS): Minimal: customer says enabling `sessionPrefetch: true` + a soft-launch with 50 users caused ~1.2k preflight calls in <30s. Paste from their edge logs: `403/429` mix, mostly 429.
Maya (CS): Log snippet: ```
[2026-02-19T14:02:11Z] tenant=nimbly reqs=1200 window=28s auth=ephemeral preflight=burst
[2026-02-19T14:02:12Z] status=429 route=/v1/sdk/preflight reason=quota_exceeded
```
Devon (SDK): That pattern screams token-prefetch + no inflight dedupe. Browser SDK v0.9.x had a prefetch path that spawns one preflight per open tab + per session start if not debounced.
Maya (CS): They're on v0.9.3.
Sahil (Oncall): Quick mitigation options: customer side — reduce prefetch concurrency + add client-side dedupe; our side — temporarily increase their burst window or allow short grace on preflight errors while we stabilize.
Alex (Platform): We can open a temporary soft quota lift for their org for 30m, but prefer client patch first since that scales. Devon, can you sketch a minimal client tweak they can apply ASAP?
Devon (SDK): Yep. Two lines: debounce prefetch and cap parallel prefetch. Example: ```js
// quick patch for v0.9.3
const sdk = new RedwoodSDK({
  sessionPrefetch: true,
  prefetchDebounceMs: 250,   // aggregate startup prefetches
  maxParallelPrefetch: 3,     // avoid stampede
});
```
Devon (SDK): Also add inflight dedupe: if there's an ongoing token fetch for a session id, return the same promise rather than starting a new one.
Maya (CS): I'll relay that. They asked for a one-line server workaround while they patch — is a short grace possible?
Sahil (Oncall): I can toggle a transient grace for `nimbly-corp` org and bump their temporary burst rate from 20r/s -> 80r/s for 30 minutes. Will need CS ticket ID.
Maya (CS): Thanks. Can you file the ticket? We need audit trail.
Alex (Platform): deploy-bot can create it if you post the summary here.
Maya (CS): Summary: "NimblePay onboarding — prefetch stampede causing preflight 429s; recommended client debounce+cap; requested 30m burst bump."
Maya (CS): @deploy-bot create ticket CS-4782 with that summary.
deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4782 created and assigned to @Sahil. Priority: P2.
Sahil (Oncall): Done. I scheduled a 30m burst bump starting now. Will monitor metrics and rollback if abnormal.
Maya (CS): I'm sending the client snippet + suggested dedupe pattern and asking them to restart the rollout.
Maya (CS): Customer reply: "applying patch now, will watch for 10m and report back" :thumbsup:
Devon (SDK): For long term, we'll push a small patch in the next minor (0.9.4) to enable safer defaults: `prefetchDebounceMs=250` and `maxParallelPrefetch=2` plus inflight dedupe. I'll open PR.
Alex (Platform): Also adding a note to onboarding docs about prefetch hazards and a recommended health-check sequence.
Maya (CS): If the 10m check looks green we'll close this. Thanks team.
Sahil (Oncall): Monitoring shows success: 429s dropped to ~2/min after patch + burst bump. I'll remove the temporary bump in 25m and leave a normal quota.
Maya (CS): Great — closing after final confirmation from customer.
Maya (CS): Customer confirmed: stable. They asked if we can review their rollout plan for future waves. I'll schedule an enablement call.
Maya (CS): Follow-ups: Devon to PR SDK defaults; Alex to update onboarding doc; Sahil to file short postmortem note on what allowed quick mitigation.
Maya (CS): Thanks all :heart:
